insurer: Aditya Birla Health Insurance Co. Limited
sumInsured: Not specified (as per Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table)

good.name: PED Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of a pre-existing Disease (PED) and its direct complications shall be excluded until the expiry of 36 months of continuous coverage after the date of inception of the first policy with Us.
good.explanation: Pre-existing diseases are excluded for 36 months from the start of coverage. This 3-year waiting period is within the acceptable market range of 2 to 4 years.

good.name: Specific Illness Waiting
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of the listed Conditions, surgeries/treatments shall be excluded until the expiry of 24 months of continuous coverage, after the date of inception of the first policy with Us.
good.reference: Section D.I.2 (Specified disease / procedure waiting period)
good.explanation: Specified illnesses and procedures are excluded for 24 months from policy start. This is a standard waiting period in the market.

good.name: Initial Waiting Period
good.quote: Expenses related to the treatment of any illness within 30 days from the first policy commencement date shall be excluded except claims arising due to an accident, provided the same are covered.
good.explanation: Illnesses are excluded for the first 30 days except accidents. This 30-day waiting period with accident exemption is standard.

good.name: Domiciliary Hospitalization
good.quote: We shall cover the Medical Expenses incurred towards the Insured Person’s Domiciliary Hospitalization, up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy
good.explanation: Home-based hospitalization is covered subject to conditions and limits in the policy schedule. This provides coverage when hospital admission is not possible.

good.name: Air Ambulance
good.quote: Domestic Emergency Assistance Services (including Air Ambulance)
good.explanation: Emergency evacuation including air ambulance is included via empanelled providers, subject to authorization and conditions. This helps in urgent medical transport.

bad.name: Room Rent
bad.quote: Reasonable and Customary Charges for Room Rent for accommodation in Hospital room and other boarding charges up to the limits as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy;
bad.reference: Section C.I.(a) In-patient Hospitalization – What is covered
bad.explanation: Room rent is capped as per the policy schedule and not unlimited. This can restrict hospital room choices and may lead to proportionate deductions.

bad.name: Proportionate Deduction
bad.quote: If the Insured Person is admitted in a room category/limit that is higher than the one that is specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy, then the Insured Person shall bear a rateable proportion of the total Associated Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: Choosing a room above the eligible category triggers proportionate deductions on medical expenses, increasing your out-of-pocket costs.

bad.name: Restore Benefit
bad.quote: The Sum Insured and/or the sub-limit for each Benefit under Section C.I is specified against that Benefit in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy.
bad.reference: Section C (Benefits Covered Under the Policy) – introductory text
bad.explanation: No restore or reinstatement benefit is mentioned, so the Sum Insured is not replenished after a claim, limiting coverage for multiple claims.

bad.name: Consumables
bad.quote: Non-Medical Expenses including but not limited to ... as specified in the Annexure B - Non- Medical Expenses and on Our website
bad.reference: Specific Exclusions, point 50; Annexure B - List of Non-Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: Common consumables like gloves and masks are excluded, meaning you may have to pay for these items out-of-pocket.

bad.name: Pre-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: We shall cover on a reimbursement basis, up to the Sum Insured for the number of days as specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy, the Insured Person’s Pre-hospitalization Medical Expenses
bad.reference: Section C.I.(b) Pre – hospitalization Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: The pre-hospitalization period is not specified in the text, so coverage cannot be confirmed and should be assumed absent.

bad.name: Post-hospitalization Cover
bad.quote: We shall cover on a reimbursement basis, up to the Sum Insured for the number of days specified in the Policy Schedule / Product Benefit Table of this Policy, the Insured Person’s Post-hospitalization Medical Expenses
bad.reference: Section C.I.(c) Post – hospitalization Medical Expenses
bad.explanation: The post-hospitalization period is not specified, so coverage cannot be confirmed and should be assumed absent.

bad.name: No NCB
bad.quote: The Policy Schedule shall specify which of the following covers are in force and available for the Insured Persons under the Policy during the Policy Period.
bad.explanation: No No-Claim Bonus or renewal bonus is mentioned, so the Sum Insured does not increase on claim-free renewals.

bad.name: Co-pay
bad.quote: Co-payment means a cost sharing requirement under a health insurance policy that provides that the policyholder/insured will bear a specified percentage of the admissible claims amount.
bad.explanation: Co-payment is defined but no specific percentage or applicability is stated, so it is unclear if or when co-pay applies.

unclear.name: Deductible
unclear.quote: All claims under these Benefits will be payable only if the aggregate of covered Medical Expenses... in a Policy Year is in excess of the Deductible as stated in the Policy Schedule/Product Benefit Table of this Policy
unclear.reference: Section C.I (Basic Covers) – applicability of deductible
unclear.explanation: The deductible amount is not specified in the text, so the threshold for claim payment is unclear.

unclear.name: Cashless Network
unclear.quote: Cashless Facilities can be availed only at Our Network Providers/ Empaneled Service Providers. The complete list of Network Providers and Empaneled Service Providers is available on Our website
unclear.explanation: A network exists but the number of hospitals is not stated, so the size and convenience of the cashless network is unclear.

unclear.name: Built-in SI Buffer
unclear.quote: The funds accumulated under HealthReturns TM may be utilized ... towards ... (i) In-patient Medical Expenses and Day Care Treatment, provided that the Sum Insured, is exhausted during the Policy Year.
unclear.reference: Section C.II.(l) HealthReturns™ – How can one spend HealthReturnsTM
unclear.explanation: HealthReturns funds can be used after Sum Insured is exhausted but this is not clearly an insurer-provided additional Sum Insured buffer; its exact nature is unclear.
